serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Y-yes… I want to know…
Landlord: I warned you… 
Landlord: Have you ever… {{wi}}seen a shit in a sink?

You: What?! That’s all? You scared me for a second!
Landlord: What do you mean ‘that’s all’?! Do you have any idea how hard it is to unclog something like that! I spent 2 hours in shit only to call for a plumber in the end!
Landlord: Besides! It’s not only a sink! These bastards leave their droppings everywhere! Behind the couch, in a washing machine! 
You: Ugh! That’s disgusting!
Landlord: I know! You don’t have to tell me, idiot!
Landlord: I’m done with this talk, see you later!
#Landlord.animate(TransparencyTo0,1)
You: Bye…
I really shouldn’t have asked…
Now at least I have some ideas for a parting gift when I’m done with this place.
